title: Compliance Memorandum: Length of the Coverage Review on Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Renewals Read From the Insulin Pharmacy Record
content:
**To:** patient services and the documentation and authorization unit. **Subject:** the length, in months, of the coverage review on a renewal grant for the CGM supply allowance (HCPCS A4239) under the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, as read from the customer's Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program.

### 1. The rule

The review-length adjustment replaces the standard review length from the customer's insulin record: when the customer's insulin pharmacy program closed the tier's follow-up visit interval or more whole calendar months before the order date, the review length is 0 months; when the latest insulin refill on that program, its ship date plus its supply days, ended on or before the order date, an insulin pharmacy program with no insulin refill on record counting as ended on the order date, the review length is the tier's follow-up visit interval in months; otherwise the standard review length applies.

### 2. Records read

The records read are those of the customer's Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program: its closed date, and its insulin refill shipments with their ship dates and supply days. The latest insulin refill is the insulin refill shipment with the latest ship date on that program, and its supply ends on its ship date plus its supply days. The order date is that of the renewal, the newest written order of the CGM supply allowance on the CGM program. Whole calendar months from one date to a later date are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's calendar day is earlier than the earlier date's calendar day. An insulin pharmacy program with no closed date has not closed before the order date.

### 3. The ladder

| Insulin pharmacy program | Latest insulin supply (ship date plus supply days) | Review length |
|---|---|---|
| closed the tier's follow-up visit interval or more whole calendar months before the order date | any | 0 months |
| not closed, or closed fewer whole calendar months before the order date than that interval | ended on or before the order date | the tier's follow-up visit interval, in months |
| not closed, or closed fewer whole calendar months before the order date than that interval | no insulin refill on record (counts as ended on the order date) | the tier's follow-up visit interval, in months |
| not closed, or closed fewer whole calendar months before the order date than that interval | ends after the order date | the standard review length |

The first row is read before the others. An insulin supply ending on the order date itself falls in the second row; one ending on the day after the order date falls in the fourth.

| Tier | Follow-up visit interval (months) |
|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 0 |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 6 |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 12 |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 6 |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 6 |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 6 |

On the CGM Original Medicare Program the interval is 6 months: a program closed 6 or more whole calendar months before the order date gives a review length of 0 months; otherwise a latest insulin supply that ended on or before the order date, or no insulin refill on record, gives 6 months; otherwise the standard review length applies.

### 4. Illustration (hypothetical dates, CGM Original Medicare Program interval)

A renewal order is dated 10 April of a hypothetical Year 1.

- The insulin pharmacy program closed on 10 October of Year 0, exactly 6 whole calendar months before the order date: the review length is 0 months. Had it closed on 11 October of Year 0, only 5 whole calendar months would have passed, because the 10th is earlier than the 11th, and the next rows would be read.
- The program closed on 1 March of Year 1 and its latest insulin refill shipped on 1 February of Year 1 with 30 days of supply, ending on 3 March of Year 1, before the order date: the review length is 6 months.
- The program closed on 1 March of Year 1 and shows no insulin refill at all: the supply counts as ending on the order date, and the review length is 6 months.
- The program closed on 5 April of Year 1 and its latest insulin refill shipped on 1 April of Year 1 with 30 days of supply, running to 1 May of Year 1, past the order date: the standard review length applies.
